method_limits: One trial per worker/channel; OS file cache was not flushed.
Baseline cost buckets cover 100 pairs; candidate throughput covers 1000 consecutive pairs.
Pair service excludes cached endpoint preparation; request-to-ready includes queueing and endpoint work. Worker-slot totals sum concurrent wall durations, not process CPU time.
Native measurements include finite-run observation overhead and use draw callbacks, not physical monitor FPS.
CPU-by-core counters are host-wide; process core-equivalents include startup/teardown and 0.5-second sampling.
No multi-hour, Windows/macOS, mixed-DPI/4K, low-RAM physical host, concurrent external solver, or human input-to-photon test.
